candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance increment with a plain assignment so prior balance is overwritten instead of accumulated.
Credit a fixed amount of 1 instead of the sent value.
Delete the balance update so deposits never change the recorded balance.
Weaken the assertion to '>=' so a zero-value deposit no longer reverts.
Change the increment to add only half the sent value (skipping, so integer division), altering the credited balance.
Delete the require statement so users can withdraw more than their balance.
Delete the balance decrement so withdrawn funds remain credited to the caller.
Move the balance decrement before the transfer, enabling reentrancy with inflated balances.
Change require to strict inequality so withdrawing the full remaining balance reverts.
